title: Bait
wikitext:
{{For|the item|Bait (item)|R=This article is about the item category.}}
'''Bait''' can be attached to a [[Fiberglass Rod]], an [[Iridium Rod]], an [[Advanced Iridium Rod]], or inserted into a [[Crab Pot]]. Fishing rods do not require bait, but fish will bite faster with bait; specialized baits provide additional benefits. Crab Pots require bait to catch [[fish]] (unless the player has the [[Skills#Fishing|Luremaster]] profession). Some specialized baits also provide benefits to Crab Pots.

Bait is always a single-use item. If the player uses a fishing rod with the [[Forge#Tool enchantments|Preserving enchantment]], for each nibble there is a 50% chance for bait to not be consumed.

==Use==
<section begin="baituse" />
Requires: {{Name|Fiberglass Rod|class=inline}}, {{Name|Iridium Rod|class=inline}}, or {{Name|Advanced Iridium Rod|class=inline}}.

Each cast uses one piece of bait or one magnet.  When all bait is used up, the game pops up a notification saying "You've used your last piece of bait."

To attach bait to a [[Tools#Fishing Poles|fishing rod]], open the [[inventory]], click on the bait ([[File:Left-Click.png|24px]] left-click or [[File:Right-Click.png|24px]] right-click, depending on how many bait will be used), and then [[File:Right-Click.png|24px]] on the rod.  To remove bait, [[File:Right-Click.png|24px]] on the rod.  

On an Xbox controller, press [[File:360 A.png|24px]] on the bait to select the whole stack (or [[File:360 X.png|24px]] to pick up a single one), then [[File:360 X.png|24px]] to attach to the rod.

On a PS4 controller, press [[File:PS4 Cross.png|24px]] on the bait to select the whole stack (or [[File:PS4 Square.png|24px]] to pick up a single one), then [[File:PS4 Square.png|24px]] to attach to the rod.

On a Nintendo Switch Controller, Press [[File:Switch A.png|24px]] on the bait to select the whole stack (Or [[File:Switch Y.png|24px]] to pick up a single one), then [[File:Switch Y.png|24px]] to attach to the rod.

Bait can be detached by pressing [[File:PS4 Cross.png|24px]] on either Controller. ([[File:Switch Y.png|24px]] on Nintendo Switch)

For the mobile version, bait can be added to the fishing rod by opening the inventory, then dragging the bait and dropping it on top of the rod. Bait cannot be conventionally removed on mobile but one type of bait may be switched out for another, which will move the bait previously on the rod back to the inventory.<section end="baituse" />

==Bugs==
*'''Mobile only:''' A stack of bait may sometimes be reduced to one piece of bait when switching bait on the fishing rod. A large stack of bait may also be used up in just a few casts of the rod.
